create_eagle_proposer: create an EagleProposer instance with vllm config and device for speculative decoding
build_spec_decode_base_proposer: build a SpecDecodeBaseProposer with vllm config, device, and hidden state passing flag for draft token generation
run_draft_model_propose: run the propose method to generate draft tokens from target model hidden states and attention metadata
build_tree_attention_draft: build tree-based draft tokens using propose_tree with logits, positions, and hidden states for multi-level speculative decoding
compute_probs_sample_token: compute probabilities and sample next token from logits using sampling metadata with temperature and greedy modes
